The '''Iego council''' was a body of government composed of residents of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. The council ruled Cliffhold and convened in the [[Cliffhold meeting hall]] when assembled. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] met with the council during their [[Mission to Iego/Legends|mission]] to recover [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa]] root from Iego. Despite opposition from council member [[Amit Noloff/Legends|Amit Noloff]], the two were able to convice the people of Cliffhold that Iego was being guarded by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|security system]], not the malevolent [[Deity/Legends|god]] known as [[Drol/Legends|Drol]].
